# Embedded Emissions: Pig Iron (CN 7201), India

**Embedded emissions = 1,266.27 tCO2e**

## Required Inputs
| Input | Value | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code | 7201 (Pig iron and spiegeleisen) | ✔ In table |
| (b) Country of production | India | ✔ Listed for CN 7201 |
| (c) Quantity | 500.5 tonnes | ✔ Provided |

All three inputs are present, so a definitive figure can be computed.

## Factor Selection
The table row for CN 7201 and India gives a default SEE of **2.53 tCO2e per tonne**.

## Calculation
Embedded emissions = SEE × quantity
= 2.53 tCO2e/t × 500.5 t
= 1,266.265 tCO2e

Rounded to 2 decimal places (round half up): **1,266.27 tCO2e**

*Rounding note:* The unrounded result ends exactly on a 5 in the third decimal place. The ruleset does not specify a rounding convention. Standard half-up rounding gives 1,266.27. Round-half-to-even ("banker's rounding") would give 1,266.26.
